title: Evening 4 — the Line: al-Buṭāḥ and the road to al-Yamāma, the Prophet's ﷺ lifetime to 11–12 AH
note: Events sit in DATE BANDS, and in COLUMNS inside a band. Position inside a band is order only, never a scale: the cards give years, and inside a year only 'before' and 'after'. Two events on DIFFERENT lanes that share a column are events the cards do not order against each other — the shared column claims only 'same band', never 'same day'; each such event says so in its note. Every event names the card(s) it comes from; 'when' is the card's own When line in English; 'certainty' is the card's own label. Nothing here goes on the image except 'label'/'short' and the band and lane names. 'short' is the label used at large text (--text 1.3 or more), which is the default.

styles.lit: gold dot, ink bold label — tonight's material, told up to this stop
styles.delivered: small teal dot, muted label — told on an earlier evening
styles.untold: hollow dot, muted label — 'later' only (rolled to a later evening). Tonight's parts not yet told at a stop are not drawn.

events.label: Musaylima's claim refused
events.when: ATA/E-TB16: in the Prophet's ﷺ lifetime, no year given (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 4373) · ATA/E-TB15: the end of the year 10
events.note: ONE point for two cards, on purpose. TB15 is dated to the end of 10 AH; TB16 carries no year, only 'in the Prophet's ﷺ lifetime'. No card fixes which came first, so they are not drawn as two points in an order. The band is the one both cards support.

events.label: Buzākha
events.note: Where evening 2 stopped. Khālid ؓ goes from here to al-Buṭāḥ (RCT/E-RC44, the runsheet's note on #7).

events.label: Sajāḥ comes to al-Yamāma
events.when: ATA/E-TB18: 11 AH · ATA/E-TB19: 11 AH, at al-Yamāma, and afterwards
events.note: Shares Buzākha's column: no card orders Sajāḥ against Buzākha. She IS fixed before al-Buṭāḥ — RCT/E-RC45 beats 2-3: Mālik ؓ had dealt with her, and regretted it when she attached herself to Musaylima and went back north, before Khālid's ؓ patrols came. The label says she came; it says nothing of the meeting (TB19's warning).

events.label: al-Buṭāḥ — Mālik b. Nuwayra ؓ
events.certainty: SOURCED; what happened on the night itself: the books disagree (RCT/E-RC48)
events.note: After Buzākha (RC44: 'Khālid ؓ comes here straight from Buzākha'). The label names the place only: Part II is told as a disagreement between books, and the Line takes no side.

events.label: The reckoning at Medina
events.note: After al-Buṭāḥ (RC49's map: the arrow returns to Medina). RCT/E-RC51 is Ibn Kathīr's own comment on this, not an event, and is not drawn separately.

events.label: Khālid ؓ sent to al-Yamāma
events.note: The hinge. RC63: the audience that excused him ended with new orders — so it takes the next column after the reckoning.

events.label: Shuraḥbīl ؓ beaten, like ʿIkrima ؓ before him
events.when: RCT/E-RC15: 11 AH, at al-Yamāma · RCT/E-RC53: 11 AH, at al-Yamāma
events.note: Placed where RC53 fixes Shuraḥbīl's ؓ defeat: while Khālid ؓ was on his way. ʿIkrima's ؓ own defeat (RC15) is NOT dated by any card against al-Buṭāḥ or the reckoning at Medina — RC64 even has him at al-Yamāma before Sajāḥ turned towards it — so the label names him without placing him (evening-4 review, facts-02).

events.label: ʿIkrima ؓ and al-Muhājir ؓ come down
events.note: Evening 3's event, with evening 3's label and band. Fixed AFTER ʿIkrima's ؓ defeat at al-Yamāma: RC15 sends him on by Oman and Mahra to meet al-Muhājir ؓ — hence the column after y03 and the link arrow. Not fixed against the day at ʿAqrabāʾ; banding puts every 11 AH point before the 11–12 AH band, exactly as evening 3's Line did.

events.label: Forty thousand at ʿAqrabāʾ
events.note: The figure is the card's own ('Three books, one figure'). RC54: Musaylima hears Khālid ؓ is coming and chooses his ground — after the hinge.

events.label: The prisoner in Khālid's ؓ tent
events.note: 'The night before the battle' (RC16 beat 1). No number of riders on the Line: the books differ — al-Bidāya about forty, or it is said sixty; al-Kāmil between forty and sixty; Siyar twenty-three (RC16's own note).

events.label: Qays and ʿAmr judged at Medina, sent home
events.when: TSY/E-YK06: 11–12 AH · RCT/E-RC32: 11→12 AH · TSY/E-YK18: 11–12 AH
events.note: Where evening 3 stopped (STOP B, after RC32). No card orders it against the day at ʿAqrabāʾ: its column inside 11–12 AH carries no claim against the al-Yamāma lane. After s01 on its own lane (al-Muhājir ؓ brought the two men to Medina after coming down).

events.label: The Muslim line breaks
events.certainty: SOURCED; RC55 the order of battle: the books disagree; RC56 who said it: the attribution is disputed
events.note: The armies form up (RC55), the call along the enemy line (RC56), the rout into the tent and the two protections (RC17), al-Rajjāl killed in the rout (RC57). One point: all four are the opening of one day.

events.label: The men of the Qurʾān
events.note: 'People of Sūrat al-Baqara' (RC58), Thābit ؓ (RC18), Sālim ؓ (RC59), Zayd ؓ (RC60), Abū Ḥudhayfa ؓ (RC61). Their deaths are told on these cards; the Line names no death and no outcome.

events.label: “Separate out” — every clan under its banner
events.note: STOP C, the planned end: the line re-formed, the day NOT decided. Nothing on the al-Yamāma lane lies to the right of this point — no garden, no death of Musaylima, no outcome. English rendering of «امتازوا» is the card's own beat 2.

events.label: Ḥaḍramawt: Kinda breaks
events.when: TSY/E-YK07, YK08, YK09: 11 AH · RCT/E-RC33: 11→12 AH, Ḥaḍramawt
events.note: Rolled to evening 5 (DECISIONS.md #44) — hollow in every render. At the right-hand end because the campaign note §12.2 establishes Ḥaḍramawt/Kinda as LAST [SOURCED as sequence; the month is not established]. It is in the 11–12 AH band, as on evening 3's Line.

events.label: The garden — the gate opened
events.note: RC20: Banū Ḥanīfa fall back into a walled garden; al-Barāʾ ؓ is thrown over the wall and opens the gate. Drawn only once Part V is told.

events.label: Musaylima killed
events.note: RC21, and the terms at the forts that follow it (RC22).

events.label: The Qurʾān gathered
events.note: RC37: after the reciters were killed at al-Yamāma, Abū Bakr ؓ ordered it gathered. Medina's lane, because that is where it was done.

links.note: Khālid's ؓ march from Medina to al-Yamāma (RC63 → RC54). Drawn only once Part III is told.

links.label: ʿIkrima ؓ sent on
links.note: RC15: not recalled — sent on by Oman and Mahra to meet al-Muhājir ؓ. The callback to evening 3 the runsheet asks for at #17.

not_drawn.ATA/E-TB12: a saying, not an event (11–12 AH, al-Yamāma); no point of its own
not_drawn.RCT/E-RC64: Thumāma ؓ holding out is a state 'before Khālid ؓ arrived', not a dated event; drawing it would force a column no card gives
not_drawn.RCT/E-RC51: Ibn Kathīr's own comment on the reckoning (m03), not an event
not_drawn.RCT/E-RC52: 13 AH onwards, in ʿUmar's ؓ caliphate — beyond this Line's right edge; drawing it would put ʿUmar's ؓ caliphate after a day the room has not seen finish
not_drawn.RCT/E-RC62: one moment of the same day at ʿAqrabāʾ, between y07 and y08; no point of its own
